pages.title: EVA Suit
pages.text: ORSA Mk.III: sealed air loop, cryogenic insulation, Frozen Heart power core.

pages.title: Specs
pages.text: $(li)$(bold)+30°C$() per piece, $(bold)+120°C$() full set$(li)Rated for all Phase 1-6 surface cold$(li)Negates wind chill$(li)Traps only +8% heat$(br2)$(flavor)ORSA Legal: the suit is on loan. Returning it in pieces counts as damaged.$()

pages.title: Vacuum
pages.text: $(danger)The suit alone gives you no air.$() In late Phase 6, stay in breathable shelter or carry $(l:orsa_equipment/o2_canisters)O2 Canisters$(/l).$(br2)Impacts can puncture it. See $(l:orsa_equipment/suit_breaches)Suit Breaches$(/l).

pages.title: Crafting
pages.text: Built on Tier 2 $(l:orsa_equipment/heavy_insulation)Heavy Gear$(/l) with ice shards, blue ice and, for the chestplate, a $(l:advanced/frozen_heart)Frozen Heart$(/l).$(br2)$(flavor)Yes, you must brave the surface to gather it. "It builds character."$()

pages.title: Caldera Retrofit
pages.text: RUPTURE calderas can cook a standard EVA shell.$(br2)Add $(bold)Sulfur Crust$() and $(bold)Volcanic Tuff$() to an $(l:orsa_rd/lined_eva)Acheronite-Lined EVA Suit$(/l) for a caloric barrier.
The barrier stops caldera overheat, $(danger)not lava contact$().$(br2)$(flavor)If it smells like minerals and bad decisions, it took.$()
Needs a Frozen Heart core.$(br2)$(flavor)Don't worry, it's not YOUR heart.$()
Blue ice, ice shards and a reinforced helmet.$(br2)$(flavor)Breathing easier starts at the top.$()
$(flavor)Mobility matters when the surface is trying to kill you.$()
$(flavor)Seal the suit from the ground up. Vacuum is a terrible thing to step into.$()

pages.title: Caldera Retrofit
pages.text: A Lined EVA Suit plus Sulfur Crust and Volcanic Tuff. The shell reads $(italic)Caldera retrofit installed.$() when it took.
